solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A search, following pet in series of tunnels

indicators.note: following says the A-and-search part comes after the pet

parts.note: a cat is a typical household pet
to comb an area is to search it thoroughly

explanation.surface: Someone hunts for a lost pet through a network of tunnels.
explanation.definitionFit: Underground burial chambers linked by passages form a network, so a series of tunnels describes them.

clue.text: Minister turning up in school given protection

indicators.note: in puts the reversed minister inside the school

parts.note: a coed is a coeducational school for boys and girls

indicators.note: turning up in a down clue means the word is read bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is a minister of religion

explanation.surface: A clergyman arrives at a school that is being sheltered.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'turning up' reads the minister bottom to top; a coed is a mixed school for boys and girls.
explanation.definitionFit: Being shielded or insured means being given protection, a synonym.

clue.text: Time to meet friend and agree

parts.note: an ally is a friend or supporter

explanation.surface: It is time to meet a friend and come to an agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: Two accounts that match are said to correspond or agree, a synonym verb.

clue.text: Test machines out — a punishing experience

indicators.note: out means the letters of test machines are put out of order

explanation.surface: Testing machinery can be a gruelling ordeal.
explanation.definitionFit: A severe scolding or beating is a punishing experience, a synonym.

clue.text: Mum swallows good hot stuff

indicators.note: swallows means the mother word takes the letter for good inside

parts.note: mama is a childish word for mum

explanation.surface: Mother downs some good hot food.
explanation.definitionFit: Molten rock beneath the earth's crust is literally hot material, so hot stuff is a playful description.

clue.text: Cut fuel coming to hospital

parts.note: gas is a fuel burned for heat
H is the map and signpost abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: Fuel is being delivered to a hospital that has had its budget cut.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep cut in the skin is a synonym, as a wound noun.

clue.text: A learner seen with sweetheart everywhere

parts.note: L is a learner driver, from the L-plate
a lover is a sweetheart

explanation.surface: A learner driver is spotted with a partner all over town.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in every place, an idiom for everywhere.

clue.text: Underworld offers comparative darkness, first to last

indicators.note: first to last means the opening letter is moved to the end

parts.note: shade is a place comparatively dark, out of the sun

explanation.surface: The underworld offers a relative gloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first to last' moves the S of SHADE to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth it is the realm of the dead, the underworld.

clue.text: A rebel, impish, naughty, going on for ever

indicators.note: naughty suggests the letters of a rebel, impish misbehave and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A mischievous rebel keeps up the bad behaviour endlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that cannot decay or die lasts for ever, so it is everlasting.

clue.text: Dwelling that's bad in Virginia

indicators.note: in places the word for bad inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: VA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
feeling bad means being ill

explanation.surface: A house in Virginia is said to be in poor condition.
explanation.definitionFit: A large country house or holiday home is a kind of dwelling, an example of the category.

clue.text: Took a chance and walked slowly beyond end of building

indicators.note: beyond says the slow-walking word comes after that letter
end of picks the final letter of building

parts.note: to amble is to walk at a slow, easy pace

explanation.surface: Someone risked a stroll past the far end of a building.
explanation.definitionFit: To bet or risk something on an uncertain outcome is to take a chance, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Boy offering a bit of illumination

definitions.meaning: a single beam or shaft of light

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a common boy's name and a narrow beam of light, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: They steal bird by roof's edge

indicators.note: by puts the roof's edge piece next to the bird

parts.note: a teal is a small freshwater duck
the eaves are the overhanging lower edge of a roof

explanation.surface: Thieves make off with a bird nesting beside the edge of a roof.
explanation.walkthrough: In Cockney rhyming slang 'tea leaves' rhymes with 'thieves', so the phrase means people who steal.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhyming slang stands in for the word thieves, so the phrase names people who steal.

clue.text: Rob is rich man with tons

parts.note: Dives is the traditional name for the rich man in the Gospel parable of Lazarus

explanation.surface: A thief robs a man who has tons of money.
explanation.walkthrough: Dives (Latin for 'rich') is the name tradition gives the rich man in the parable of Dives and Lazarus.
explanation.definitionFit: To strip someone of possessions is to rob or deprive them, a synonym.

clue.text: I had smallest room, four, set up for composer

indicators.note: set up in a down clue means the pieces are read bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: I'd is the contraction of I had
the smallest room is a jokey name for the lavatory, the lav
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone reports having a tiny room set up for a group of four.
explanation.definitionFit: Antonio of The Four Seasons was a Venetian Baroque composer, an example.

clue.text: Strange grit is found in river

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters of grit is are in an odd, rearranged order

explanation.surface: Odd gritty sediment turns up in a river.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the great Mesopotamian river flowing through Turkey and Iraq, an example of a river.

clue.text: Reliable American gold coin no longer used

parts.note: solid means dependable, reliable

explanation.surface: A dependable American gold coin has gone out of circulation.
explanation.definitionFit: It was the Roman and Byzantine gold coin, long obsolete.

clue.text: Nothing dull with companion: the perfect coupling?

parts.note: love means a score of zero in tennis
matt or mat means without shine, dull
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: A dull life with a partner hardly sounds like the ideal pairing.
explanation.walkthrough: CH is Companion of Honour, a British honour. The question mark flags the definition as playful.
explanation.definitionFit: A marriage made purely for affection is playfully called the ideal pairing of two people.

clue.text: You're solver somewhat upset, one lacking success?

indicators.note: upset says the hidden letters are read backwards
somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: The setter teases the solver as someone who keeps failing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somewhat' pulls RESOL from 'You're solver'; 'upset' turns it round in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who fails or is beaten is one lacking success, a direct description.

clue.text: Greek character in the group of volunteers

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: A Greek figure turns up among a band of volunteers.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, a written character.

clue.text: Note the Sun

definitions.meaning: the fifth note of the ...-fa scale, also spelt so
the Latin name for the sun, used in astronomy

explanation.definitionFit: It is a sol-fa musical note and also the Latin name of our star, two separate senses.

clue.text: Poet's always following street guide

indicators.note: following says the poet's word comes after the street letters

parts.note: e'er is the poetic contraction of ever, always

explanation.surface: A poet always trails behind a street guide.
explanation.definitionFit: To direct or steer a course is to guide, a synonym verb.

clue.text: The French in immoral act with church saying nothing

indicators.note: in places the French article inside the immoral act

parts.note: a sin is an immoral act
le is French for the
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A Frenchman commits an immoral act in church without a word.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying nothing is the state of quiet, a noun phrase matching the absence of speech.

clue.text: Soldiers tucked into lousy food

indicators.note: tucked into puts the soldiers inside the word for lousy

parts.note: lousy means bad
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: Troops eat some awful rations.
explanation.definitionFit: Baked loaves are a staple food, so this is the everyday example of food.

clue.text: Game in disarray

parts.note: RU is rugby union, the game

explanation.surface: A sports match is in a mess.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of collapse or wreckage is a kind of disarray, a loose synonym.

clue.text: Male into karate's mad to start fighting

indicators.note: into puts the male letter inside the rearranged karate letters
mad says the letters of karate's are jumbled wildly

explanation.surface: A man crazy about karate is spoiling for a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mad' turns KARATES into TAKEARS; 'into' puts M inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to pick up weapons, that is to begin combat.
